Hello! I am an author, designer & cartoonist who moonlights as an art teacher.

I make art out of my converted Bluebird bus. I also spend my time as a creative director, teaching drawing and digital media in the surrounding community as well as making music and other creative pursuits. Thanks for coming by and feel free to reach out to me about any creative opportunities.

Artist Bio

Josh Tuininga is an author, artist, and graphic designer based in North Bend, WA. A graduate of the School of the Art Institute of Chicago, Tuininga's artistic career has explored a variety of mediums including sequential art, animation, painting and design. In 2003, he founded an Art + Design Agency, The Medium where he continues to work as Creative Director.

Josh is the author of ‘We Are Not Strangers’ (Abrams ComicArts 2023), and two children’s books, Why Blue? & Dream On. He also makes music with his wife as To the River. You can find information about his events and classes here.

The Bus

Tuininga’s art studio is a 1978 converted Bluebird bus. It is filled to the brim with numerous art supplies and musical instruments and it has been retrofitted with a wood stove to keep the studio warm and cozy.
